title: Sugar Rush
problem: May skip a buff after each removal (array walk).

verified_in_game.result: bug confirmed: 1 buff kept after Sugar Rush's end-of-turn removal

notes: Fix: H User 2026-10-26: in-game test: one buff was kept, not removed, at end of turn. Confirms the forward array walk skips the element after each removal. Fix: walk the conditions array backwards (or don't advance after a removal). | 2026-10-26 hook batch F1 built (research/hooks_F1.json, loader/hooks_F1.c). Stands in for the loop's scr_CritRemoveCondition (bc_CreatureEndOfTurn L240): if the conditions count dropped, the loop's own skip-increment flag is set so the same index is checked again. A buff that resists removal leaves the count unchanged, so the walk still advances (no endless loop). In-game test: Sugar Rush creature with 3+ buffs: all removed at the end of its turn.

release_notes.intended: At the end of the creature's turn, all its buffs are removed.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, each removal skipped the next buff, so about half the buffs stayed.
release_notes.fix: Now all of the creature's buffs are removed.
